title: 12G-SDI — Transport of Multiple 6Gb/s, 3Gb/s or 1.5Gb/s signals on a 12G-SDI link
scope: This Standard defines the combination of 1.5G-SDI signals, 3G-SDI signals and 6G-SDI signals into a 12GSDI interface. • MODE 1: Carriage of two SMPTE ST 2081-10 6G-SDI signals on a 12G-SDI 10-bit interface as defined in section 7 Single-link 12G-SDI 10-bit Multiplex • MODE 2: Carriage of four SMPTE ST 425-1 3G-SDI signals on a 12G-SDI 10-bit interface as defined in section 7 Single-link 12G-SDI 10-bit Multiplex • MODE 3: Carriage of eight SMPTE ST 292-1 HD-SDI signals on a 12G-SDI 10-bit interface as defined in section 7 Single-link 12G-SDI 10-bit Multiplex
